violated_contract: Every hermetic regression guard for a production behavior must be registered in the checks manifest and run in the local and CI lanes; an unregistered guard can stop importing or drift while the repository reports green.
canonical_prevention: Register each regression suite with an explicit manifest id, narrow source triggers, and both local and CI lanes. Keep the suite hermetic and run the manifest-selected command in preflight so import drift and behavioral regressions fail closed instead of becoming invisible.
